name: PostHog Analytics Report
author: hearth-team
description: Read-only product-analytics pulse from your PostHog project. This skill only READS via HogQL queries — it never writes. report='summary' (default) returns total event volume over the last 7 days plus the top 10 events by count. report='top_pages' returns the top 10 $current_url values from $pageview events over the last 7 days. Bring your own POSTHOG_API_KEY (a read-only personal API key), POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID, and posthog_host (default https://us.posthog.com; use https://eu.posthog.com for EU cloud or your self-hosted URL).

vault_inputs.label: PostHog personal API key
vault_inputs.help: Create at PostHog → Settings → Personal API keys → 'Create personal API key'. Scope it read-only (Query Read is enough). Starts with 'phx_'. This is NOT the phc_ project write key. Stored encrypted in your vault.

vault_inputs.label: PostHog project ID
vault_inputs.help: The numeric project id — find it in PostHog → Settings → Project, or in the app URL (/project/12345).

vault_inputs.label: PostHog host
vault_inputs.help: https://us.posthog.com (US cloud, default), https://eu.posthog.com (EU cloud), or your self-hosted instance URL.
